description: "A View of Sir Isaac Newton's Philosophy" by Henry Pemberton is a scientific publication written in the early 18th century. This work serves as a commentary and introduction to the groundbreaking ideas and methodologies developed by Sir Isaac Newton, a pivotal figure in the scientific revolution.
